# Rodentia
Rodentia are a race of humanoid beings resembling rodents. Resourceful, evasive, sneaky, but fragile.
## Benefits
- Their claws do Slash and Blunt damage. - Smaller than humans. - Can fit in duffelbags. - Crawl about 75% faster than other species while lying down. - Can safely eat raw meat. - Can consume Theobromine (chocolate, tea, coffee) and Allicin (onion, garlic) without toxin damage.
## Special
- Can rummage through disposal chutes for food, trash, and occasionally useful materials. - Can store small items in their cheeks. Having items in their mouth makes their speech unintelligible, and they will drop all items in their mouth if attacked, stunned, or shoved.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Blunt damage[/color] - Always triggers mousetraps, regardless of whether or not they are wearing shoes. - Gets hungry 33% faster. - Cannot vomit to expel ingested substances.
